description: This file defines the DefaultTimesheetModel class, which implements the Normalizable interface. It provides a method to convert a Timesheet entity to an array suitable for serialization, including details such as id, status, startDate, and endDate. It is part of the OrangeHRM Time Module API models.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing Timesheet data into an array format including id, status, startDate, and endDate.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Timesheet entity to initialize the model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Timesheet entity into an associative array with relevant properties for API responses.
